text: We recently tried a chicken sandwich at Crimson Chicken and unfortunately had a disappointing experience. Initially, we were on a chicken tour and stopped by Raising Cane's first but decided to try Crimson Chicken due to their enticing social media advertising. While their chicken looked great, the taste left much to be desired. The sandwich was dry, overly seasoned, and lacked moisture despite the standard toppings. We opted for the Crimson Sandwich, priced at $12.23 after tax. Shortly after eating, both my wife and I started feeling unwell. I had a persistent scratchy sensation in my throat for an hour, while my wife experienced stomach discomfort, as did I. Reflecting on it, we suspect the sandwich was excessively salty due to over-seasoning. The wait time was short, only 5-7 minutes, but it seemed like there was a lack of care in preparation. The bathroom was dirty, which was also concerning. Initially, the customer service was okay, but when we called to report our issue, it took a turn for the worse. My wife was hung up on twice before finally speaking with a manager, who is also the owner. Unfortunately, the response was equally dismissive and rude. We were shocked by the lack of concern for food and customer safety. We don't plan on returning due to the poor food quality and terrible customer service. We hope this review helps others make an informed decision and prevents someone from having a similar experience.

text: Absolutely phenomenal! Crimson Coward isn't just a Nashville hot chicken restaurant; it's an experience from start to finish, earning every single one of these five stars. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere sets the perfect tone. It's vibrant, energetic, and incredibly inviting, with a cool, modern twist on classic hot chicken joint vibes. They were happy to answer questions about the heat levels (which, trust me, are no joke!) and made excellent recommendations. Their passion for the food and commitment to excellent service truly shines through, making the entire dining experience even more enjoyable. And then there's the food – oh, the food! Delicious doesn't even begin to cover it. The Nashville hot chicken is a masterpiece. Crispy on the outside, incredibly juicy and tender on the inside, and packed with flavor that goes beyond just heat. We tried a few different spice levels, and each one was perfectly balanced, allowing the incredible chicken to be the star. The sides are just as impressive, from the creamy mac and cheese to the tangy coleslaw, each complementing the chicken perfectly. You can tell they use high-quality, fresh ingredients, and it makes all the difference. Crimson Coward is a must-visit for any hot chicken lover, or really, anyone looking for a truly delicious and memorable meal. This place is a gem, and we'll definitely be back for more!

text: UPDATED January 2026: We recently ordered from Vocelli Pizza via UberEats. The Uber Eats site is poorly set up for this pizza place, as there’s no way to modify specialty pizzas (I want extra sauce) or create your own pizza and make half toppings on the pizza – this can be changed by the restaurant, they just need to do it. We ordered their Quatro Cheese and an order of their pepperoni rolls. The food was delivered quickly and was still a decent, warm temperature when it arrived, which is how we prefer pizza. We want it as hot and fresh as possible. This pizza tasted GREAT! Very very good! Regarding the extra sauce I wanted, I called the restaurant after placing my UberEats order and asked them if they would add extra sauce to our order and the young man on the phone said he would… and he did! It was perfectly made, with a nice amount of their tasty sauce on it. The pepperoni rolls are legitimately some of the best I’ve had. I’ve been to many places in Pittsburgh, where they sell them everywhere and where Vocellis was founded and the pepperoni rolls I get from my two local Vocellis are just as good as any I’ve had up there. Definitely will order from this location again! ______________________________________________________________ It had been a couple of years since I’ve had Vocelli’s so we used Uber Eats to give them a try recently. They had a promotion of free peperoni rolls with a large pizza, so we got a large peperoni pizza and those pepperoni rolls. The pizza was great! Very tasty, especially the next day after reheating it. The crust was spot on, flavorful, and tender! The little peperoni they use cups up nicely too and the cheese was great. I just wish it had a little more tomato sauce on it. I opted for a side of the garlic sauce to go with it as a dip and that sauce was awesome! Great for dipping the crust into!! The pepperoni rolls were so good and very soft, tender, and not dry or hard. Dipping them into a side of their tomato sauce really finished them off perfectly! text: I recently tried Vocelli Pizza at 754 Warrenton Road and I must say I was thoroughly impressed. The pizza was delicious and exceeded my expectations. I will definitely be returning for more of their delicious pizza.
